The Governor is pleased to order the publication of the following English translation of notification
no. 145/Eight-7-26-126vivid-14T.C.-1, dated February 11, 2026:
No. 145/Eight-7-26-126vivid-14T.C.-1
Dated Lucknow, February 11, 2026
WHEREAS, the State Government has decided to implement the project of ropeway for public transport
facility in Varanasi city;
AND, WHEREAS, National Highway Logistics Management Limited has been authorized by the Government
of Uttar Pradesh for the implementation of the aforesaid project;
NOW, THEREFORE, in exercise of the powers under sub-section (1) of Section 6 of the United Provinces
Aerial Ropeways Act, 1922 (U.P. Act no. 1 of 1922) read with Section 21 of the Uttar Pradesh General Clauses
Act, 1904 (U.P. Act no. 1 of 1904) and in partial modification of notification no. 1464/Eight-7-22-126Vividh-
14T.C.-1 dated 02-12-2022, the Governor is pleased to publish the following draft of the proposed order authorizing
the construction, by or on behalf of National Highway Logistics Management Limited, of the aerial ropeway along the
GPS Co-ordinates of Stations and Towers as listed in Schedule 1 and Schedule 2 below respectively for the Pilot
corridor of Ropeway Project in Varanasi (Cantt. Railway Station-Kashi Vidyapeeth-Rathyatra-Girjaghar Chauraha-
Godowliya Chowk).
Objections or suggestions with respect to the proposed order shall be sent in writing addressed to the District
Level Committee constituted in accordance with the Government Order no. 572/Eight-7-22-126Vividh/14T.C.-I dated
06-07-2022. Only such objections or suggestions shall be taken into consideration as are received within 15 days from
the date of publication of this notification in the Official Gazette.
